data.name: Full Carnage
data.detailed_description:
Arcade racing full of chaos and destruction in a low poly style.
In Full Carnage, it’s not just about winning – it’s about survival. Smash into opponents, break through obstacles, and turn every track into total mayhem.

Choose from multiple game modes – classic circuit races, fast-paced sprints, or brutal destruction derby arenas. Every race is unpredictable, packed with crashes, explosions, and moments where pure chaos decides the outcome.

Both the environment and the cars react to every impact. Destroy barriers, barrels, and everything around the track, and watch vehicles gradually turn into piles of scrap. The more aggressively you drive, the more carnage you create.

Play solo or challenge a friend in split-screen multiplayer and find out who can handle the chaos best.

 Key Features

  •  Fast-paced arcade racing gameplay

  •  Destructible environments and vehicles

  •  Multiple game modes: circuit, sprint, destruction derby

  •  Local split-screen multiplayer

  •  Stylized low poly visuals

  •  Intense, unpredictable, high-speed action
